title: Business-card website in Russian and English
lead: Who you are, how you work and how to reach you, readable on one phone screen.
problem: A person who arrives from a job reply or a social network should understand within a minute who you are, how you help and how to write to you, on a phone too.
built: Sections: about, how I work, projects, resume, contacts, linked to each other.
Two language versions with a switcher; each project has its own page.
Pages fitted to a phone: text reads without zooming.
A sitemap and language versions set up for search engines; the build has 20 addresses and 8 projects.
steps: Short intro and how you work.
Projects, each with its own page.
The same in a second language, with a switcher.
offer: A site in 1-2 languages from your texts and images, design and a phone check.
Site files ready to put on your hosting.
not_included: Domain and hosting (you pay for them); A request form, a shop, a personal account; Writing the texts.
